objectives.title: Reach the compound
objectives.description: Get off the dock and find a way into the estate grounds.

objectives.title: Breach the service entrance
objectives.description: The main gate is watched. Find the staff way in.

objectives.title: Find a staff keycard
objectives.description: The interior door is badge-locked. Someone on shift must have left one behind.

objectives.title: Unlock the interior door
objectives.description: Use the service security node to release the door to the office wing.

objectives.title: Search the office
objectives.description: The guest wing office holds the paperwork that proves who was here.

objectives.title: Corroborate the story
objectives.description: One document is a claim. Two matching records are a story. Find what backs it up.

objectives.title: Pull the server archive
objectives.description: The office terminal still talks to the estate server. Download what's left.

objectives.title: Route the broadcast signal
objectives.description: The relay is cold. Route the signal to the tower from the office security node.

objectives.title: Broadcast the evidence
objectives.description: Transmit everything from the tower relay before they reach you.

objectives.title: Reach the server bunker
objectives.description: The relay feed routes through the estate's server room, under the security wing.

objectives.title: Reach the broadcast tower
objectives.description: The relay console sits above the bunker. Get to it before they find you.

objectives.title: Follow the money
objectives.description: Rumor says a private ledger page survived the shredding.
